# Summer camp: kit list (14th Hollin Scouts)

## Each tent (one patrol of 6)

- Tent with fly sheet and ground sheet
- 6 sleeping mats
- 1 lantern

## Each Scout brings

- Sleeping bag, warm jumper, waterproof coat
- Torch and spare batteries
- Water bottle (1 litre)
- Wash kit and towel
- Neckerchief and woggle

## Leave at home

- Phones and games consoles
- Sweets and fizzy drinks
- Knives (the troop knife is shared)

## Pick-up

Sunday 13 July at 2pm, at the site gate. Parents please arrive by quarter to two.
